slides.title: people displaced in southern Ethiopia, aid group says

slides.text: Islamic Relief says about **329,000** are displaced in **Dawa zone, Somali Region**, and **359,798** in **southern Oromia**.
The group says the conflict has spread up to **300 km** from **Moyale**, and about **50,000** people have fled into **Kenya**.
Islamic Relief says it is giving **cash aid and hygiene kits**, but access is **challenging** and **funding is needed**. The government has not commented, AFP reports.
**Protect civilians, open aid access.** Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Islamic Relief, AFP via Arab News, Nov 19, 2026
